name: Firozkoh

queries.query: Afghanistan official cadastral map parcel Firozkoh Ghor land records GIS
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Ministry of Urban Development and Housing (MUDH) land-affairs/cadastre responsibilities and an official Firozkoh detailed-plan announcement. No anonymous city-specific parcel viewer, feature service, or safe parcel geometry endpoint was found.

queries.query: افغانستان فیروزکوه غور کادستر نقشه زمین ثبت اراضی رسمی
queries.result: نتایج رسمی وزارت شهرسازی و مسکن/اراضی از سروی، ثبت و پلان تفصیلی زمین در غور و فیروزکوه خبر می‌دهند، اما واسطۀ عمومی نقشه پارسل یا پاسخ برداری ناشناس با شناسه امن و هندسه پیدا نشد.

registryEvidence: MUDH is evidenced as the national land-affairs custodian: its official land-affairs page assigns geodesy, cadastre, deed registration, cadastral surveying, and land-information modernization responsibilities. Official MUDH results also document detailed planning in Firozkoh and surveying/registration of state land in Ghor. This is custodian and activity evidence, not evidence of a local public parcel registry or anonymous geometry service.
uncertainty: Firozkoh municipality, the Ghor provincial land-affairs office, or MUDH may maintain operational cadastral records or non-public map services. The municipal HTTPS endpoint presented a self-signed certificate, so it was not accessed under the default TLS policy; no certificate exception was authorized. No absence inference is made from timeouts, TLS failure, login walls, or lack of a public endpoint. Packet completion is research completion only and is not source integration or runtime admission.
